g.text: status : VARCHAR(32) ' DRAFT | READY_TO_FILE | FILED_ACCEPTED | FILED_REJECTED | VOIDED | SUPERSEDED | PENDING_RECONCILIATION
unit_key_trailer_plate : TEXT ' null si no aplica
destinations : JSONB ' set de destinos (ids normalizados)
- Snapshots (parties, route, vehicle) are immutable after FILED_*
- Active-overlap policy: no two active waybills for the same
- PENDING_RECONCILIATION stubs may be created from webhooks
- Each partition maps 1:1 to a physical unit (tractor + optional trailer)
- Destinations across partitions must be disjoint and cover all required
Transactional Outbox: published after commit with retries/backoff
